title: The pipeline cannot log in
scenario: "Every infra run fails since this morning with AADSTS700213. Nobody touched the pipeline." — Incident channel (GD-05)
mission: Diagnose a federation failure (authentication, not RBAC), fix it in Terraform and write the post-mortem.
objectives: Tell federation errors from RBAC errors
Compare token subject vs credential subject

prerequisites.notes: Ask someone (or a sealed instruction) to change one subject in 05-identity without telling you which.

steps.detail: Which part of the token did Entra reject?

steps.title: Compare
steps.detail: Token subject from the error vs federated credentials.
steps.command: az ad app federated-credential list --id <github_client_id> -o table

steps.title: Post-mortem
steps.detail: docs/postmortems/GD-05.md: What happened · Impact · Root cause · Detection · Prevention.

criteria.text: The three expected subjects are back

concepts.title: Read the error code first
concepts.body: Entra errors start with `AADSTS`. `AADSTS700213` (and similar 7002xx) means the presented token did not match any federated credential — an *authentication* problem. `AuthorizationFailed` on a scope means the identity is known but lacks a role — an *authorization* problem. Different layers, different fixes.

concepts.title: Post-mortems
concepts.body: A blameless post-mortem answers: what happened · impact · root cause · how we detected it · what we change so it does not happen again. Five short sections are enough.

example.title: comparing what was presented with what is trusted
example.body: The error message contains the presented subject; list the trusted ones and compare character by character:
example.code: az ad app federated-credential list --id <client-id> --query "[].subject" -o tsv

glossary.def: Prefix of Entra ID (Azure AD) security token service errors.
Post-mortem style focused on systems, not people.

recovery: If the error is AuthorizationFailed instead, you are in the RBAC layer — different fix.
dont: Do not add a client secret as a workaround
hints: AADSTS700213 means no matching federated identity record.
The error message prints the presented subject.
Plan on PR for the identity layer would have shown the change.

interview.question: A pipeline suddenly fails to authenticate to Azure. Walk me through your diagnosis.
followUps: Authentication vs authorization — how do you tell them apart in Azure?

debrief: Federation errors (AADSTS7002xx) are about the token/subject; RBAC errors are AuthorizationFailed on a scope. Fix in Terraform, prevent with plan-on-PR and CODEOWNERS on the identity layer.

checker.plan: Read-only: az ad app federated-credential list, gh run list --workflow infra.yml, post-mortem file headings.
